## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Passeig de Gràcia.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Antoni Gaudí was a genius of Catalan Modernism and you'll learn the intricacies of his crazy world in Barcelona's Casa Batlló. Be the first in the house and immerse yourself in a fairytale world thanks to the latest augmented reality technology!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €50.62. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 105 ratings and 64 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
